sourceVersion: 军团战争 v14.1A5 · 九倍怪物

contract.limitCountPolicy: max(group-count,all-owned-unit-count), excluding replaced unit and dead units; exact type or base_id lineage unless limitid_ex

sourceEvidence.progressionPolicy: Direct hero egg route reviewed against source recipe and user correction; BoxGift provides optional discounted training.
sourceEvidence.nativeHeroClassification: Primary of the mapped combat object; Web altar-family identity does not imply UNIT_TYPE_HERO.
sourceEvidence.pricingPolicy: Normal numeric catalog adapters retain their existing empty-field fallback; original missing fields remain absent in buildingRawFields.

directUpgrade.policy: Hero eggs are direct upgrades from their completed hero. BoxGift is an optional 40% price route, not an unlock requirement. Native Upgrade fields are absent from the CSV packet; these five routes combine the user's correction, source recipe descriptions and exact BoxGift target IDs. Do not turn every training selection into an ordinary upgrade.
